title: A Verdict for the Ledger
author: I. M. Blackwood
blurb: Lena Villalobos, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the statute expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
